units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 14:1">Pesik. R. s. 14</cite> the sand stands before the Ocean <he>כט׳ וכחומה</he> like a dam and a wall (cmp. <cite ref="I00361"><he>טִיכְסָא</he></cite>). [It is not likely that our w. is the Greek τεῖχος, which is identical in meaning with <cite ref="H00373"><he>חומה</he></cite>.]
